page.overview:
Who is Fujiko Fujiyama?

Fujiko Fujiyama (藤山不二子 Fujiko Fujiyama) is the main character featured in the non-canon manga Fujiko´s Bizarre Worldy Wisdom. She is a Stand user, and wields the Stand, Bad Romance. She is also an inmate at Green Dolphin Street Prison who sells paintings to other inmates for money.

Fujiko has black hair, and wears glasses. she wears a T-shirt that has comic book panels on them. Since she is an artist, she has a pencil and sketch-board on her at all times. The sketch board is held on her shoulders.

Fujiko has what could be described as an introverted personality. She finds excitement through drawing and has more of an obsession of drawing erotic art. It is also shown that she feels joy when complimented. As shown when she becomes infatuated with Jolyne after she compliments her art, and allows Fujiko to draw her.

Born in Japan around the year 1987, Fujiko was raised in the United States. With an obsessive passion for drawing, Fujiko stabbed her landlord who told her to stop wasting her time drawing. She was then charged and sent to Green Dolphin Street Prison.
